title: Plaza Field Battle
text: “Well, forget about me, but Itsuki and Ren—”
“It’s Kelsus, woof!”
Ren was being awfully particular about that. Had he tossed his own name aside, I wondered?
“As for me, I look like a pioneer fairy, but I suppose I should explain properly-pyon. What about you, Wolf?”
“Vof, know Hero Legend. Already studied local manners. Have been here before, with brother.”
“Well, ever since Wolf got his memories back, he’s had a pretty wide range of knowledge. He even teaches Theo lessons.”
“Pehn!”
That Wolf was buttering up to Father with words like that. Hmph! There was no way it could match my adorable appearance-pyon!
“So anyway, I think it’d be good if we got taught the basics about the hunting grounds-pyon.”
“Ehh, understood.”

And so, Ren and Itsuki listened to a sort of basic-course guide about the hunting grounds, I say. Father seemed to have picked up on the gist of it too. Basic knowledge like not stealing monsters that other adventurers were already targeting, that sort of thing.
“Itsuki, you especially need to be careful, I say. With your attack range, you could easily end up snatching kills away from other adventurers.”
“I know, I know. I won’t be arrogant and snipe things. I’ll just confirm with Rishia-san and the rabbit guy before attacking, right?”

“Yeah, that should work. I’ll explain it to Theo myself. That way there shouldn’t be any mistakes. Besides, once we head deeper into the island, there won’t be nearly as many adventurers around anyway.”
True enough. Heading to the deepest part sounded like a fine idea, I thought.
“Though, I do wonder if Rabbit Guy will actually stay away from Naofumi-san on this island.”
“What do you mean by that?”
“Oh, nothing, just that there seem to be a lot of people around you who might get a bit carried away with island fever, so I figured he’d want to keep watch.”
“They wouldn’t cause that much trouble, would they?”
“Pehn!”
Wolf was hopping about in Peckul form. Quite the skillful trick, I say. Crocodile Guy and Rabbit Guy were both glaring at him for it.
“R-Ren— er, Kelsus-sama. They’re selling bone-in meat over there, look. Shall I go buy some?”
“Don’t need it, woof! Don’t try to bait me with food, woof!”
“Ehh… wouldn’t it be better to just take it?”
“It’d suit you—”
“Shut up, woof! I can make something like that myself in no time, no need to buy it, woof!”
Ren was rejecting his companions’ thoughtful gesture. And so, while listening to this basic sort of chatter, we arrived in front of a totem I recognized.
“If we do a shoulder-carry here, doesn’t a hidden island surface or something?”
“Need the matching tool while doing the shoulder-carry, nano.”
Rival came fluttering down to explain. It seemed she’d already secured the item from somewhere.
“But before that, it’d probably be good to learn the spell written on that stone tablet over there, nano.”
“Yes, that’s exactly what I wanted to learn. I think it’d be extremely convenient to have.”
“Yeah, exactly!”
And so Ren and Itsuki began deciphering the spell inscribed on the stone tablet, trying to learn it. Father too, apparently.
“Hmm, hmm…”
“Since I studied properly, I can memorize this. I’m glad I learned the script of this other world—though it makes me want to gag, since it’s the writing of the so-called superior beings, humans.”
“That’s because Motoyasu-kun’s a good teacher. Itsuki, don’t overdo it, okay?”
I was just teaching Father the exact same thing Father had taught me, I say.
Hm!? My instincts were whispering to me!

“I, the Bow Hero, command the heavens, command the earth, sever the principle, bind it anew, and let the corruption be purged. O power of the dragon vein, become one with my magic and the power of the hero—I, the wellspring of power, the Bow Hero, so command. Decipher the myriad of creation once more, and bring ruin upon all that they are!”

“I, the Love Hunter, command the heavens, command the earth, sever the principle, bind it anew, and let the corruption be purged. O power of the dragon vein, become one with my magic and the power of the hero—I, the wellspring of power, the Love Hunter, so command. Decipher the myriad of creation once more, absorb the demonic power, and forge it into strength!”
“Liberation Down X.”
“Liberation Absorb X!”
Itsuki had fired off a surprise spell at me, so I countered by absorbing it with Absorb, I say!
“Tch! You countered it!?”
“Itsuki!?”
“Fuhahahaha! A surprise attack on me is useless-pyon!”
I raised my spear and absorbed the spell Itsuki had fired, nullifying it completely-pyon!
“I’d heard about it beforehand, so I thought if I hit you with a surprise attack, your stats would drop drastically and I could finish you off.”
“I can use a spell that turns me into a lightning rod for magic and absorbs it-pyon!”
Itsuki and I squared off, glaring at each other.
“A failure, huh!”
Ren readied himself to join the fray too, but he looked frustrated that Itsuki’s spell hadn’t worked.
“Yeah, yeah. Let’s not start a Cal Mira Island plaza field battle of party animals, nano.”
Father stepped in between us to scold us.
“If it had worked, I thought we might actually be able to beat you.”
“Well, it is true that Itsuki’s stat-lowering magic seems to be pretty powerful.”
“E-Ehh, um…”
“Haah… I thought this would stay peaceful, but you’re trying to start a brawl here too…”
Crocodile Guy let out a sigh. Not my problem, I say.
“Spear Hero’s little stunt nearly turned this into a weird brawl, nano.”
It was Itsuki who’d picked the fight in the first place, I say.
“Then let’s just say the match starts once Naofumi-san casts a buff spell on us. Think of it as a handicap.”
“That’s exactly the kind of fight we’re not having here. If we actually went at it for real, it wouldn’t be funny anymore.”
“It’s just skinship.”
“Don’t tell such an obvious lie, Itsuki, nano.”
“Well, I suppose it can’t be helped. I really did want to make Motoyasu-san suffer a bit, just once, but I’ll settle for having him pet me instead, since this seems like the perfect chance.”
Itsuki was being incredibly high and mighty about it.
“Grr, gnnh! I say!”
“What kind of fight even is this… honestly. Anyway, back to business—Itsuki’s got Down, and I’ve got… um, Aura, I think—”
“Mine seems to be a spell called Zweite Magic Enchant. Well, I’ve been taught all sorts of things, so I might be able to arrange it into a Liberation version.”
“Yeah, that’s true. You did end up studying all sorts of things while touring around with the circus, after all. You’ve learned effects from Motoyasu-kun, Rafumi-chan, and Gaelion-chan too.”
“I already know the content itself. I see, so it’s this kind of spell… The timing to use it is the tricky part.”
“Ren-san. If you enchant your sword with my Down and attack Motoyasu-san with it, couldn’t you turn it into a stat-lowering sword?”
“A magic sword that lowers stats would be amazing if it worked. I wonder if the effects would stack?”
“I’m Kelsus, woof!”
“Ah, that’s the part you’re sticking with, huh…”
Ren was demanding a correction over having been called by his real name.
“Motoyasu-kun’s spell is kind of similar too, isn’t it.”

“It doesn’t enchant the spear with magic, I say. But while I’m chanting the spell and holding the spear aloft, I can absorb every spell in the surrounding area. It’s quite effective against Rival, who specializes in magic, I say.”
“The weakness is Rival knows you can’t move while doing it, nano. So Rival will just go in with physical attacks, nano.”
Rival wasted no time exposing the weakness of my spell, damn it.
“A magic-sealing type spell… or more like a special action, really. From what I gather, Motoyasu-kun’s turns himself into a lightning rod.”
“Indeed, I say!”
Once it became a Liberation spell, it could even absorb Ceremonial Magic, and the range was quite wide too.
“In my mind, it feels like the kind of thing Eclair-san would be able to use.”
“Why Eclair-sama?”
Crocodile Guy questioned Father’s muttering.

“Ah, well… it’s just that in a story I know, the character who could use that kind of special skill happened to be a female knight. Now that I think about it, maybe it overlaps a bit with the image of Eclair-san being held captive and all that…”
“That’s a joke Naofumi from other loops brings up pretty often too, nano.”
“Well, if he knew about Eclair-san after hearing about the spell Motoyasu-kun uses, I guess he’d say it too.”
Just an association, I say. It was one of those moments where I could tell exactly what Father was thinking. Apparently, there’s a game character who uses an ability similar to my Absorb.
